cases.description: 'Long HUT sold the 12/19 $36 puts' — 'sold' verb overrides Long badge → SHORT direction, leg side=SELL

input.rawHtml: Long HUT sold the 12/19 $36 puts for a credit of $0.88/contract

cases.description: 'Short Bought QCOM Nov (21) $160 puts' — 'Bought' verb overrides Short badge → leg side=BUY

input.rawHtml: Short Bought QCOM Nov (21) $160 puts $12.25
input.author: Pete

cases.description: 'Sold 10 $180 Puts on NVDA' — no-badge sell-to-open must be EXECUTE, not commentary

input.rawHtml: Sold 10 $180 Puts on NVDA for $1.80 - expiring tomorrow
input.author: Hariseldon

cases.notes: Bug: no-badge sell-to-open was classified as commentary. Fix: 'Sold' verb + symbol = OPEN action.

cases.description: LEAP add-on 'Added to SPY Leaps' — must emit long-dated expiry, not nextFriday()

input.rawHtml: Added to SPY Leaps - now 50 total contracts $38.97 avg
input.author: testTrader

cases.description: LEAP with Short badge 'added another 10 the leaps' — badge is view, not direction → LONG CALL

input.rawHtml: Short SPY - added another 10 the leaps - total 60 - avg. $27.67 - 3/26 - $600
input.author: testTrader

cases.notes: Bug: v10 classified as SHORT STOCK. Fix: 'Short' badge is bearish VIEW. 'added another 10 the leaps' = LONG CALL. '3/26' = March 2026 expiry, '$600' = strike.

cases.description: PCS direction: 'Long GLW pcs 68/67 for .63 credit' — PCS = credit spread = SELL higher/BUY lower PUT
cases.notes: Bug: PCS treated as direction=LONG. Fix: PCS = credit spread = legs are SELL higher/BUY lower PUT. 'Long' is stock view not trade direction.

cases.description: CDS with 'next week' expiry hint: 'Long UNH cds for next week expiration'

input.rawHtml: Long UNH cds for next week expiration
input.author: testTrader

cases.notes: Bug: LLM omitted legs entirely → system defaulted to nextFriday(2025-09-19) = same-day expiry. Fix: orchestrator resolves 'next week' expiry from market data. CDS = call debit spread: BUY lower, SELL higher.

cases.description: Lotto with 'weeklies' expiry: 'Short C Lotto weeklies $95.50 puts' — Lotto = BUY, 'weeklies' must not crash

input.rawHtml: Short C Lotto weeklies $95.50 puts for .15
input.author: testTrader

cases.description: Loss-per-contract exit: 'Exit MSTR for a .11 loss on the lotto' — must CLOSE, not skip

input.rawHtml: Exit MSTR for a .11 loss on the lotto - not enough time left
input.author: Hariseldon

cases.notes: Bug: '.11 loss per contract' was not recognised as a CLOSE and auto-closed at expiry. Fix: Exit badge + symbol + loss context = CLOSE action.

cases.description: 'oct 3 calls' expiry hint: 'Long UNH added some straight oct 3 calls'

input.rawHtml: Long UNH added some straight oct 3 calls
input.author: testTrader

cases.notes: Bug: LLM omitted legs → system defaulted to nextFriday(2025-09-19) = same-day expiry. 'oct 3' = October 3rd expiry, orchestrator resolves concrete date.

cases.description: Reversal trade: 'taking the loss on TXN long and shorting it' — must emit CLOSE + OPEN SHORT STOCK, not just one signal

input.rawHtml: Doing a rare reversal trade, taking the loss on TXN long (-$8.40) and shorting it at $199.06 , 1,000 Shares
input.author: Hariseldon

cases.notes: Misclassification risk: treating as single CLOSE (missing the short open) or single OPEN (missing the close). 'taking the loss on TXN long' = CLOSE existing long. 'shorting it at $199.06' = OPEN SHORT STOCK. Must produce 2 signals.

cases.description: Exit short stock: 'Exit TXN with $1.74 profit per share' — must CLOSE the short, not skip as commentary

input.rawHtml: Exit TXN with $1.74 profit per share (1,000) - some mitigation against the Long loss
input.author: Hariseldon

cases.notes: Misclassification risk: 'mitigation against the Long loss' could confuse LLM into thinking this references the long position. Exit badge + TXN symbol = CLOSE the current SHORT position.

cases.description: 'Long QS via selling the Sept (19) $9.50 puts @ $.50' — coordinated extraction: strike=9.50, premium=0.50, expiry=Sep 19, direction SHORT from 'selling'

input.rawHtml: Long QS via selling the Sept (19) $9.50 puts @ $.50
input.author: testTrader

cases.notes: Bug: old system had 4 cascading failures: (1) strike regex skipped $9. and captured '50' → strike=50, (2) premium regex captured $9.50 first → premium=9.5, (3) 'selling' not matched by SOLD_RE, (4) 'Sept' not matched by month regex. Fix: coordinated token extraction assigns $9.50+puts=strike, $.50+@=premium, Sept+(19)=expiry. 'selling' added to SOLD_RE.
